title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterUse
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterUse. This class is used to define the different uses of water. It is a root class in the SAREF4WATR ontology (no rdfs:subClassOf asserted), with no properties of its own. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of WaterInfrastructure.isIntendedFor): Agriculture ('Use of water for the farming of plants and livestock.'), Aquaculture ('Use of water for the farming of fish, crustaceans, molluscs, aquatic plants, algae, and other organisms.'), Domestic ('Use of water for domestic purposes.'), Industry ('Use of water for industrial purposes.'), Recreation ('Use of water for recreational purposes.').

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WaterUse'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
